status: Exploratory research on already observed history; no untouched out-of-sample claim
source: Existing plain Excel daily panel and native project AlgoPack TradeStats five-minute bars
breakout: First daily close beyond latest confirmed same-kind pivot of level 1, 2 or 3 as known at previous close; no prior close beyond that pivot since its date. Same-day same-direction signals deduplicated at highest currently known level.
structure: Latest confirmed opposite level-1 pivot available before breakout; frozen at signal. This is a local structure invalidation, not a claim that the whole level-3 or level-4 trend reversed.
scale: Simple average of 20 true daily ranges through signal day (ATR20); source-observed dates, including weekend trading. Sensitivity excluding weekend observations.
limit_anchor: Frozen breakout-day high for longs / low for shorts; swing retracement uses the frozen opposite level-1 pivot. Entry prices rounded toward deeper pullback to MOEX tick 0.01.
invalidation_stop: Frozen opposite confirmed L1/H1 plus one tick beyond. A standing limit crossed by an opening gap fills at the better opening price; a gap beyond invalidation causes immediate exit with costs. Inactive conditional trailing patterns are cancelled on structural breach.
target: 2 times actual entry-to-stop distance, same risk unit across strategies
funding: Historical SwapRate if verifiably available; otherwise price-path study with explicit funding exclusion, never presented as net investable return
uncertain_intrabar_order: Five-minute bar touching entry and target cannot take target until following bar. If stop and target both touched in the same bar, adverse stop first. Same-bar new-high/low ordering never uses unobserved path.
optimization: Maximize mean outcome in entry-to-stop R per original signal, assigning zero to unfilled signals; train 2022-2024, select once, report 2025 and matured 2026 separately. Also report return in price units and percent, fill rate, stop/target rates, missed continuation, and conditional success.
overlap: All signals descriptive; separately fixed 20-session cooldown across both directions for nonoverlapping outcome windows. Chronological regimes can still correlate.
first_correction: First 0.50 ATR20 adverse move from previously observed post-breakout extreme. Freeze that peak/trough, measure deepest correction until recovery by one tick, structural invalidation or horizon. Same-bar recovery and invalidation resolved adversely.
contexts: H1/H2/H3 and L1/L2/L3 separately; long/short separately. Retrospective level-4 labels only descriptive, never used for signal generation or strategy selection. Strong candle subgroup: directional close location >=75% and daily range >=ATR20.
current_application: Breakout on 2026-10-05 of 85.61; forecast frozen to close of Oct05. Any later quote is a separately timestamped follow-up, not a training input.
funding_missing_policy: Missing published SwapRate remains unavailable; no zero imputation. Funding comparison excludes the same incomplete whole outcome windows for every strategy.
standing_limit_gap_policy: Standing limits crossed by an opening gap fill at the better opening price; gaps beyond invalidation cause immediate exit with costs. Inactive conditional trailing patterns are cancelled on structural breach.
additional_extension_hypothesis: After fixed-entry results, a separate predeclared grid activates a trailing pullback entry only after advance 0, 0.5, 1 or 1.5 ATR beyond the broken level; depths 0.25,0.5,0.75,1 ATR. Only past completed five-minute peaks may update the next-bar order. Same chronological split; this is exploratory, not an untouched test.
publication_clarification: The invalidation_stop text above reconciles the original protocol with its later standing_limit_gap_policy and the executed simulator. Numerical results are unchanged; the original protocol and full individual-event results remain local.
